components.css: :host{--paper:#fff;--dot:#d5dae5;--card:#fff;--line:#e3e6ee;--field:#fff;--ink:#1c2333;--mute:#5b6476;--red:#e0262b;--on-red:#fff;--red-ink:#c81e24;--green:#13804f;--hl:#ffc6dc;--hl2:#fff09a;--hl3:#bff0d8;--hl4:#cfe3ff;--hl5:#e5d8ff;--mark:#ff6fa4;--note:#fff3a6;--note-ink:#3a3110;--tape:rgb(255 150 190 / .55);--lift:rgb(28 35 51 / .08);--wash:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,var(--card));font-family:"Noto Sans Georgian",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-i{width:1.2em;height:1.2em;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round} .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;font:700 16px/1.2 inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s,transform .1s} .ds-btn:hover{border-color:var(--ink)} .ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--mark);outline-offset:2px} .ds-go{width:100%;min-height:58px;font-size:19px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:var(--on-red);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -10px var(--red)} .ds-go:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 86%,#000);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 86%,#000)} .ds-fill{fill:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4}

components.css: :host{--paper:#fff;--dot:#d5dae5;--card:#fff;--line:#e3e6ee;--field:#fff;--ink:#1c2333;--mute:#5b6476;--red:#e0262b;--on-red:#fff;--red-ink:#c81e24;--green:#13804f;--hl:#ffc6dc;--hl2:#fff09a;--hl3:#bff0d8;--hl4:#cfe3ff;--hl5:#e5d8ff;--mark:#ff6fa4;--note:#fff3a6;--note-ink:#3a3110;--tape:rgb(255 150 190 / .55);--lift:rgb(28 35 51 / .08);--wash:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,var(--card));font-family:"Noto Sans Georgian",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-box{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px 18px 18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px var(--lift),0 8px 24px -12px var(--lift)} .ds-box::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-9px;left:50%;width:92px;height:22px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);background:var(--tape) repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgb(255 255 255 / .25) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px)} .ds-cap{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:12px} .ds-note{padding:16px 14px;background:var(--note);color:var(--note-ink);border-radius:4px 4px 14px 4px;transform:rotate(-.6deg);box-shadow:0 6px 14px -8px var(--lift),0 1px 2px var(--lift);font-size:44px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25} .ds-ka{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:20px;font-weight:600}

components.name: Letter Cells
components.description: Grid-paper cells: ghost, right (mint swipe, green), wrong (red pen).
components.css: :host{--paper:#fff;--dot:#d5dae5;--card:#fff;--line:#e3e6ee;--field:#fff;--ink:#1c2333;--mute:#5b6476;--red:#e0262b;--on-red:#fff;--red-ink:#c81e24;--green:#13804f;--hl:#ffc6dc;--hl2:#fff09a;--hl3:#bff0d8;--hl4:#cfe3ff;--hl5:#e5d8ff;--mark:#ff6fa4;--note:#fff3a6;--note-ink:#3a3110;--tape:rgb(255 150 190 / .55);--lift:rgb(28 35 51 / .08);--wash:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,var(--card));font-family:"Noto Sans Georgian",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-cells{display:flex;gap:5px} .ds-cells b{width:48px;aspect-ratio:4/5;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:30px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;color:var(--ink);background:var(--field) no-repeat 0 0/100% 100%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px} .ds-cells .ds-g{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mute) 80%,var(--card));border-style:dashed} .ds-cells .ds-ok{color:var(--green);border-color:transparent;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--hl3) 0 0);animation:ds-swipe .25s ease-out both} .ds-cells .ds-bad{color:var(--red-ink);border-color:var(--red);background-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--red) 9%,var(--field));text-decoration:underline wavy var(--red) 2px;text-underline-offset:5px} @keyframes ds-swipe{from{background-size:0 100%}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cells b{animation:none!important}}

components.css: :host{--paper:#fff;--dot:#d5dae5;--card:#fff;--line:#e3e6ee;--field:#fff;--ink:#1c2333;--mute:#5b6476;--red:#e0262b;--on-red:#fff;--red-ink:#c81e24;--green:#13804f;--hl:#ffc6dc;--hl2:#fff09a;--hl3:#bff0d8;--hl4:#cfe3ff;--hl5:#e5d8ff;--mark:#ff6fa4;--note:#fff3a6;--note-ink:#3a3110;--tape:rgb(255 150 190 / .55);--lift:rgb(28 35 51 / .08);--wash:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,var(--card));font-family:"Noto Sans Georgian",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-h2{position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:fit-content;margin:0;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2} .ds-h2::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:-5px;right:-7px;bottom:.1em;height:.55em;background:var(--hl);border-radius:.35em .6em .45em .25em;transform:skewX(-14deg) rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:left;animation:ds-marker .6s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.2,1) .1s both} @keyframes ds-marker{from{transform:skewX(-14deg) rotate(-1deg) scaleX(0)}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-h2::after{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
The app is a student's neatest notebook. The page is white dot-grid paper; everything that holds content is a white sheet with a thin rule and a soft lift; text is written in a blue-black gel pen; colour arrives only the way a good student adds it, with pastel highlighters, one yellow sticky note and a strip of washi tape. The logo red is the teacher's red: it marks the one thing to do next and it marks mistakes. Green pen marks letters written right.

Density is calm and single-column: one 760px column, the same on phone and desktop, with the navigation moving from a top tab strip (desktop) to a bottom tab bar (phone). Headings are heavy and short, each with a highlighter swipe that sweeps in behind it on arrival. Icons are one line-icon set drawn at the same 1.8 stroke everywhere; free-form emojis survive only as "stickers" (avatars, user-typed lesson names), never as interface icons.

Eight styles exist, and all eight are the same notebook in different paper: they swap the page, highlighter and sticky-note colours, never the structure, the type or the component shapes.
keyCharacteristics: White dot-grid ground (22px grid), white cards with a 1px rule and a soft two-layer lift.
Gel-pen ink for text, logo red for the single main action and for mistakes, green pen for right answers.
Five pastel highlighters plus one saturated marker, used as swipes, fills and icon circles, never as text colour.
Sticky note for the next word; washi tape on the day's card.
Noto Sans Georgian at normal width, 400 to 800; headings 800.
One line-icon set (24-unit grid, 1.8 stroke, 1.2em) that scales with its text.

rules.name: The Teacher's Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears in exactly two roles: the one main action of a view, and the red pen on a mistake. It is never decoration, never a heading colour, never a second button in the same group.

rules.name: The Highlighter Not Ink Rule
rules.body: Pastels sit behind or around text (swipes, fills, circles, pills); they are never the text colour. Text stays `ink`, `mute`, `green` or `red-ink`.

rules.name: The Same Notebook Rule
rules.body: A style variant may only change colour tokens. Shapes, type, icons and layout are identical across all eight.

rules.name: The Weight Not Width Rule
rules.body: The face stays at normal width; emphasis is weight 700-800. No condensed or stretched settings.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and tinted by `lift`; no hard offset shadows, no thick borders. Depth beyond a sheet comes from paper objects (note, tape), not stacked shadows.

dos: Do keep one red action per view; mark mistakes with the red pen (`red` border, wavy underline, `red-ink` text).
Do use mint swipe plus green ink for right, and keep highlighters behind text.
Do put new section headings on the marker swipe (app h2) or `.mk` span (public h1/h2).
Do draw any new icon on the 24-unit grid at 1.8 stroke and add it to the sprite and the emoji map.
Do cycle pastel circles through `hl`, `hl4`, `hl3`, `hl2` (and `hl5` for six-step sets).
Do use colour tokens only, so all eight styles keep working; test new UI in paper and dark.
Do let `prefers-reduced-motion` drop every animation and transition: swipes, ink-in and flips show their end state at once.
donts: Don't use emoji as interface icons; emoji are stickers for avatars and user-typed names only.
Don't use hard offset shadows, thick black borders or dark board panels.
Don't condense or stretch the type, or add a second display face.
Don't add mascots, chunky gamified cards or 3D badges.
Don't let a style variant change shapes, layout or icons.
